# Rest Easy Services

Rest Easy Services is a professional cleaning and property care company based in Capel Sound, Mornington Peninsula, Victoria, Australia. Since 2012, the team has provided residential cleaning, Airbnb and holiday rental cleaning, vacate (bond) cleaning, linen hire, gardening, house maintenance, locksmith, carpet cleaning, pressure washing, and NDIS cleaning services across the Mornington Peninsula, the Frankston region, and Melbourne's south-eastern suburbs.

## About

- Trusted cleaning and property care provider since 2012 (14+ years experience)
- Trained, insured, and police-checked staff
- Flexible scheduling with weekly, fortnightly, monthly, or one-off services
- Residential, holiday rental, Airbnb, NDIS, and commercial cleaning solutions
- Additional property services including linen hire, gardening, house maintenance, locksmith services, carpet cleaning, pressure washing, and car park cleaning
- Rated 4.4 stars from 34+ Google reviews

## Location

Rest Easy Services is headquartered in Capel Sound, Mornington Peninsula, Victoria, Australia, and proudly provides professional cleaning and property care services throughout the Mornington Peninsula, the Frankston region, and Melbourne's south-eastern suburbs. Service coverage includes Capel Sound, Rye, Rosebud, Dromana, Mount Eliza, McCrae, Hastings, Mornington, Mount Martha, Safety Beach, Somerville, Blairgowrie, Tootgarook, Portsea, Red Hill, Balnarring, Somers, Bittern, Crib Point, Tyabb, Frankston, Carrum Downs, Chelsea Heights, Patterson Lakes, Skye, Langwarrin, Seaford, Aspendale, Keysborough, Brighton, Glen Waverley, Wheelers Hill, Mount Waverley, Toorak, Doncaster, Donvale, Box Hill, Burwood, Vermont, and Camberwell.
